plan.coverage_notes: Plan emphasizes architectural patterns, core techniques (planning, tool use, memory, multi-agent), and practical concerns (evaluation, failure modes, cost, deployment) relevant to a hands-on engineer. Skips pure theory, neuroscience-inspired cognitive architectures, and highly specific application domains (e.g., chemistry, finance) not mentioned in the profile. Includes a query on software engineering as a natural subspecialty intersection.
